data.motto: Together in Stewardship, Kindness, and Purpose
data.missionStatement: To cultivate a warm, resilient, and well-ordered home where every generation is supported, heard, and equipped to thrive.
data.visionStatement: A multi-generational household operating with zero financial ambiguity, shared responsibility, and enduring family traditions.
data.familyIdentityStatement: The Henderson Household stands for intentional living, calm cooperation, and celebrating every person's unique strengths.
sharedAspirations: Gather for unhurried family meals at least four evenings every week.
Support each member’s educational, creative, and personal wellbeing goals.
Maintain a debt-free, transparent, and generous household economy.
memberCommitments: We listen first with empathy before offering correction or advice.
We honor our shared home spaces and leave rooms better than we found them.
We repair misunderstandings quickly and never let resentment linger overnight.
data.legacyStatement: May the habits of kindness, courage, and stewardship we practice in this home ripple outward to bless our community and future generations.

data.title: Sunday Evening Gratitude & Roast Dinner
data.meaningAndOrigin: Started when our household was founded so that no matter how busy the week becomes, we close Sunday with homemade food and each person sharing three things they appreciated.
memoriesAndNotes: Everyone takes turns lighting the table candle and reading the weekly gratitude jar notes.

data.title: Annual Year-End Reflection & Vision Retreat
data.meaningAndOrigin: A two-day family retreat where we review our photo gallery from the past 12 months, celebrate milestones, and set our shared goals for the coming year.
memoriesAndNotes: Includes writing time-capsule letters to open the following December.

data.title: Friday Family Strategy Board Game & Homemade Pizza Night
data.description: Unplugged evening of cooperative board games, homemade sourdough pizzas, and family trivia.

preparationChecklist.text: Prep pizza dough in the afternoon
Dock phones in charging station at 6:15 PM

data.title: Device-Free Meals & Restful Bedrooms
data.principleStatement: We prioritize face-to-face connection during meals and protect restful sleep by docking phones and tablets in the kitchen charging station by 9:00 PM.
practicalExpectations: All phones, tablets, and earbuds stay off the dining table during breakfast and dinner.
Youth devices dock in the common charging station 45 minutes before bedtime.

data.title: Shared Spaces Evening Reset
data.principleStatement: A calm morning begins the night before. Every member contributes 10 minutes after dinner to reset the kitchen, living room, and entryway.
practicalExpectations: Clear personal items, backpacks, and shoes from the living room and hallway.

data.bioAndHeritageStory: Taught your father how to sketch buildings, measure twice before cutting once, and value patience. He still builds heirloom oak bookshelves in his workshop.
conversationStarters: Ask Grandpa Arthur what was the tallest building he ever helped design.
Ask him to show you how he carves dovetail joints in his workshop.

growthAreas.title: Digitizing 40 Years of Architectural Blueprints & Family Letters
growthAreas.description: Helping Grandpa organize and scan his hand-drawn sketches and family history journals into digital archives.
growthAreas.howKidsCanSupport: Interview him for 15 minutes on video call and label each sketch together.

growthAreas.title: Daily Mobility & Knee Strengthening Walks

encouragementNotes.message: Thank you for teaching the kids how to play chess with patience and grace!

data.workplaceOrSpecialty: Royal Botanic Conservatory & Youth Seed Library
data.bioAndHeritageStory: Grew up tending orchards and paints watercolor illustrations of medicinal and heirloom plants. She started our Sunday roast dinner tradition.
conversationStarters: Ask Grandma Bea which vegetables are easiest for kids to grow at home.
Ask her about the secret spice in her Sunday apple crumble.

growthAreas.title: Publishing Her Illustrated Family Recipe & Herb Book
growthAreas.description: Compiling her botanical drawings and family recipes into a printed keepsake book.
growthAreas.howKidsCanSupport: Test-bake her recipes together and send photos for the book pages.

data.workplaceOrSpecialty: Thames Clean Water & Suspension Bridge Projects
data.bioAndHeritageStory: Your father’s younger brother who loves building suspension bridges, running marathons, and mentoring young engineers in STEM.
conversationStarters: Ask Uncle Sam how engineers keep giant bridges from swaying in strong winds.
Ask him what his favorite science experiment was when he was 10 years old.

growthAreas.title: Executive Leadership Transition & Work-Life Rest Rhythm
growthAreas.description: Stepping into Regional Engineering Director while protecting restful weekends.
growthAreas.howKidsCanSupport: Send him encouraging voice notes before his big project presentations.

encouragementNotes.message: Praying for wisdom and calm as you lead the new bridge safety team in London!

data.workplaceOrSpecialty: Storytelling, African & Diaspora Folklore, and Youth Literacy
data.bioAndHeritageStory: Raised your mother with a deep love for books, proverbs, hospitality, and music. She has mentored hundreds of university students and writes children’s fables.

Ask her what books your mother loved reading most when she was a child.

growthAreas.title: Recording Audio Stories of Maternal Family Origins

encouragementNotes.message: Your stories at dinner inspire the children to read and write with such imagination!
